title: Grammatical precision in answer sentences
body:
- Completely redesigned AST plan clarification generator (generate_plan_clarification) to construct grammatically clean English sentences directly from relation nodes (e.g. "The country is west of Finland." or "The country is not south of Norway.").
- Eliminated broken string concatenation artifacts like "The country does not is the country..." on directional and identity questions.
- Preserved instant in-game spoiler-free clarity and full post-game detailed facts.
- Your saved game progress, streaks, and normal game limits are unchanged.
